actors: registered shopper with an active account
preconditions: Shopper has an active account on staging.aurora-shop.dev
Shopper is on the login page

rules.reading: The account locks after exactly 3 consecutive failed login attempts.
The account stays locked until the shopper resets the password; no automatic unlock.
rules.sourcePhrase: it may unlock after some time or stay locked until I reset my password

rules.reading: Only password logins count; SSO and social logins are unaffected.

numbers.name: Automatic unlock window
numbers.sourcePhrase: it may unlock after some time

outcomes: Account is locked and password logins are rejected
Shopper must reset the password to regain access
assumptions: Failed attempts are counted consecutively per account, not per device
A successful login resets the failed-attempt counter
